@statusbar.machine.turnedOff.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it is switched off (never started).

@statusbar.machine.running.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it is running (executing).

@statusbar.machine.pausing.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it is in the middle of pausing.

@statusbar.machine.paused.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it is paused.

@statusbar.machine.stopping.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it is in the middle of stopping.

@statusbar.machine.stopped.context: IDE status bar: state of the emulated machine - it has been stopped.

@statusbar.compile.inProgress.context: IDE status bar: the project's build (compilation) is running.

@statusbar.compile.notCompiled.context: IDE status bar: the project has not been built (compiled) in this session.

@statusbar.compile.failed.context: IDE status bar, shown in the error colour: the last build of the project had errors.

@statusbar.compile.success.context: IDE status bar: the last build of the project succeeded.

@statusbar.history.chip.context: IDE status bar chip while the debugger shows a point in the recorded execution history. Keep the leading ⟲ symbol. A click returns to the present.

placeholders.step: How far back in the history, already formatted, e.g. '-3 steps'

statusbar.history.tooltip: Showing the execution history: memory shows the present. Click to return to the present.

@statusbar.history.tooltip.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's history chip. The registers show the past position; the memory still shows the live (present) state.

@statusbar.reverse.inputIgnored.context: IDE status bar reverse-debugging chip when keyboard/joystick input was dropped because the machine is replaying the past.

placeholders.text: The reverse-debugging status, already formatted, e.g. '⟲ -1.24 s · step -3,412'

@statusbar.reverse.takeOver.context: IDE status bar button beside the reverse-debugging chip: continue running from the past point shown, discarding the recorded future.

statusbar.reverse.takeOverTooltip: Continue from this point: the recorded future is discarded (asks first)

@statusbar.reverse.takeOverTooltip.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's 'Take over here' button.

statusbar.automation.label: Automation

@statusbar.automation.label.context: IDE status bar item shown while the automation server (scripts driving Klive from outside) is listening and no client is connected.

statusbar.automation.clients: Automation · {clients, plural, one {# client} other {# clients}}

@statusbar.automation.clients.context: IDE status bar item shown while automation clients (external scripts) are connected to Klive.

placeholders.clients: Number of connected automation clients (1 or more)

statusbar.automation.tooltip: Automation is on: scripts on this computer can drive Klive. Click to show the Automation output.

@statusbar.automation.tooltip.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's Automation item, no client connected. 'Automation output' is the output pane of that name.

statusbar.automation.tooltipLevel: Automation is on (level: {level}): scripts on this computer can drive Klive. Click to show the Automation output.

@statusbar.automation.tooltipLevel.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's Automation item, no client connected, with the permission level the server runs at.

placeholders.level: Automation permission level identifier, shown verbatim (not translated)

statusbar.automation.tooltipConnected: Automation is on: scripts on this computer can drive Klive. {clients} connected. Click to show the Automation output.

@statusbar.automation.tooltipConnected.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's Automation item while clients are connected.

placeholders.clients: Number of connected automation clients (1 or more)

statusbar.automation.tooltipLevelConnect: Automation is on (level: {level}): scripts on this computer can drive Klive. {clients} connected. Click to show the Automation output.

@statusbar.automation.tooltipLevelConnec.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's Automation item while clients are connected, with the server's permission level.

placeholders.level: Automation permission level identifier, shown verbatim (not translated)
placeholders.clients: Number of connected automation clients (1 or more)

statusbar.basicCompiler.tooltip: BASIC programs build with {compiler}. Click to choose the compiler or set up Boriel BASIC.

@statusbar.basicCompiler.tooltip.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar item that names the compiler used for the focused BASIC file. Boriel BASIC is a product name.

placeholders.compiler: Compiler product name, 'Klive BASIC' or 'Boriel BASIC'

@statusbar.cursor.line.context: IDE status bar: abbreviation of 'Line' before the code editor's cursor line number.

@statusbar.cursor.column.context: IDE status bar: abbreviation of 'Column' before the code editor's cursor column number.

@statusbar.selectMachine.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar chip that shows the machine's name; a click opens the machine selector.

@statusbar.speed.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar chip that shows the CPU clock frequency; a click opens the speed (clock multiplier) menu.

@statusbar.menu.performanceInfo.context: Item of the emulator status bar's right-click menu (a toggle): shows the frame times, frame count and PC on the left of the bar.

@statusbar.menu.mediaInfo.context: Item of the emulator status bar's right-click menu (a toggle): shows the media (tape, disk) information strip.

@statusbar.menu.layersStrip.context: Item of the emulator status bar's right-click menu (a toggle), ZX Spectrum Next only: shows the strip of display layers.

@statusbar.menu.hide.context: Item of the emulator status bar's right-click menu: hides the status bar.

@statusbar.menu.emulatorSettings.context: Item of the emulator status bar's right-click menu: opens the Settings dialog on the emulator page.

@statusbar.rzx.tag.rec.context: Short tag on the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX input recording is being made (or waits to be saved).

@statusbar.rzx.tag.video.context: Short tag on the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording is rendered to a video file.

@statusbar.rzx.tag.play.context: Short tag on the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording plays back.

statusbar.rzx.unsaved: The RZX recording stopped and is not saved: {message}

@statusbar.rzx.unsaved.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge when an RZX input recording stopped and waits to be saved. RZX is a file format.

placeholders.message: Why the recording stopped, from the recorder, shown verbatim (may be empty)

@statusbar.rzx.recording.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX input recording is being made. RZX is a file format.

statusbar.rzx.rendering: Rendering an RZX recording to video

@statusbar.rzx.rendering.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording (file name unknown) is converted to a video.

@statusbar.rzx.renderingFile.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording is converted to a video.

@statusbar.rzx.playing.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording (file name unknown) plays back.

@statusbar.rzx.playingFile.context: Tooltip of the emulator status bar's RZX badge while an RZX recording plays back.

@statusbar.reverse.stopped.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). Reverse debugging switched itself off. Keep the ⚠ sign.

statusbar.reverse.searching: ⟲ Searching back… {count, plural, one {# interval} other {# intervals}}

@statusbar.reverse.searching.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). Reverse Continue is searching the past, interval by interval. Keep the ⟲ sign.

placeholders.count: How many keyframe intervals were searched so far

@statusbar.reverse.replaying.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). The machine replays from the past toward the present. Keep the ▶ sign and the ' · ' separator.

placeholders.time: A machine-time duration as Klive formats it, e.g. '1.24 s', '800 ms'

@statusbar.reverse.behind.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). How far in the past the machine stands. Usually kept as it is.

placeholders.time: A machine-time duration as Klive formats it, e.g. '1.24 s', '800 ms'

@statusbar.reverse.deep.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). The point in the past is older than the recorded instruction history.

placeholders.time: A machine-time duration as Klive formats it, e.g. '1.24 s', '800 ms'

@statusbar.reverse.step.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). How far in the past, and which recorded instruction step.

placeholders.time: A machine-time duration as Klive formats it, e.g. '1.24 s', '800 ms'
placeholders.step: The step back in the history, e.g. '−3,412'

@statusbar.reverse.withFile.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). Joins the status with the debug recording's file name. Usually kept as it is.

placeholders.status: One of the reverse-debugging status texts
placeholders.file: The debug recording's file name, shown verbatim

@statusbar.reverse.recording.context: IDE status bar, reverse-debugging item (single line, no wrapping). A reverse-debugging timeline opened from a debug recording file, at the present.

placeholders.file: The debug recording's file name, shown verbatim

@statusbar.reverse.tip.stopped.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several.

placeholders.reason: Why it stopped, shown verbatim (English, technical)

statusbar.reverse.tip.searching: Reverse Continue is replaying the past, keyframe interval by interval. Click to cancel.

@statusbar.reverse.tip.searching.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several. 'Reverse Continue' is the name of a Debug menu command.

statusbar.reverse.tip.replaying: The machine runs from the past toward the present; the recorded input plays.

@statusbar.reverse.tip.replaying.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several.

statusbar.reverse.tip.navigating: The machine stands in the past: every panel shows that moment. Click to return to the present.

@statusbar.reverse.tip.navigating.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several.

statusbar.reverse.tip.deep: The point is older than the history window: the history shows the run up to it.

@statusbar.reverse.tip.deep.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several.

statusbar.reverse.tip.inputIgnored: Input ignored while in the past ({count}): use Take over here to continue from this point.

@statusbar.reverse.tip.inputIgnored.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several. 'Take over here' is the name of a command that continues live from the past.

placeholders.count: How many key presses were ignored

@statusbar.reverse.tip.range.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several. How far back the machine can go.

placeholders.time: A machine-time duration as Klive formats it, e.g. '1.24 s', '800 ms'

statusbar.reverse.tip.recording: Opened from the debug recording {file}: its past is the file's

@statusbar.reverse.tip.recording.context: Tooltip of the IDE status bar's reverse-debugging item; one line of several.

placeholders.file: The debug recording's file name, shown verbatim
